verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a drag-and-drop email editor where you can edit content, appearance and module locations, prebuilt email templates (event, newsletter, engagement), and reusable custom modules that can be added to drag-and-drop emails. The pack does not document personalization tokens, and nothing shows emails rendering correctly across email clients; the template previewer evidence covers CMS templates with viewport options, not email-client rendering. missing for 10: documented personalization tokens, cross-client email rendering/testing, brand-kit or on-brand controls specific to email, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Once you've created a marketing email, you can edit its content, appearance, and module locations.
For example, you can use event, newsletter, engagement templates, and more.
Once you've created a custom module that supports programmable email, you can add that module to emails created in the drag and drop editor.
